method:
Capture the original primary desktop Accounts authorization URL offline.

The original initializer, client-ID decoder, 28-scope producer, PKCE producer,
primary URL owner and nested URL/query serializers execute under Unicorn.
Only standard allocation/string/stream/locale operations, supplied 32-byte
entropy, a SHA-256 provider and time() are substituted. No URL/query decision
is implemented here. No app, browser, account, profile or socket is opened.
limits: Whole primary URL owner with supplied campaign, callback, flow mode, DPoP thumbprint and time; no browser execution.
Actual immutable desktop client ID and scope vector are produced by the original initializer/decoder/scope routine.
PKCE uses the original producer with supplied standard entropy and a successful standard SHA-256 provider.
Callback cases execute original owner0x101670c9c and raw query lookup0x101f54d20 to its original token-task factory boundary.

Token form fields execute original0x1016721e0 with a successful supplied proof result, followed by original serializer0x10167d228. Browser/error-preflight admission and actual proof generation are separate.
No browser HTTP headers, callback server/network delivery, complete token exchange, transport fingerprint or account acceptance is proved.
